summary: Artelo Biosciences filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing that Nasdaq's new $5,000,000 minimum market value of listed securities rule, SEC-approved July 22, 2026, had identified roughly 180 companies including Artelo as below the threshold. A temporary stay announced July 29, 2026 suspended the rule, and on October 5, 2026 the SEC published Nasdaq's proposed rule change tying the operative date to stay termination, with comments due October 29, 2026. Artelo states no compliance plan is committed and it is not soliciting transactions; watch for stay termination or reinstatement risk.
